title: Huly footer
description: A single quiet dark row: muted copyright, two plain links, a row of small icon links and a warm sign-off in the highlight colour at the far end. On phones it stacks, centred: icons, links, copyright, sign-off.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); continues huly-cta seamlessly
social icons come in as props (lucide has no brand icons)
name: huly-footer

props.name: copyright
props.description: e.g. "© 2026 Tessel Labs. All rights reserved."

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: icon links; the label is read out by screen readers

props.name: note
props.description: a small warm sign-off at the far end, with an optional icon

props.name: tone
props.description: dark forces the dark colours (as on the original); inherit follows the page
